description: This file defines the MessageDataBuffer class and its nested DataBuffer class, which manage inter-process communication buffers with doorbell signaling, including methods for data push, pop, wait, and buffer management.

classes.name: MessageDataBuffer
classes.description: Manages shared memory buffers with doorbell signaling for message passing between processes.

classes.name: DataBuffer
classes.description: Nested class handling cyclic buffer operations and doorbell signaling.

methods.name: MessageDataBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer filenames and state.

methods.name: ~MessageDataBuffer
methods.description: Destructor releasing resources and unlinking buffers if initialized as server.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the data filename associated with the buffer.

methods.name: PushData
methods.description: Writes data into the cyclic buffer and signals the other process.

methods.name: PopData
methods.description: Reads data from the cyclic buffer after doorbell ring.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for doorbell signal within specified timeout.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is valid.

methods.name: PrepareFilenames
methods.description: Generates filenames for buffer files based on parameters.
